data.completion_memo: Audited and repaired the failed M11.1 implementation. The journal now verifies durable headers and every chain link, uses restart-safe OS advisory single-flight locking and owner-only atomic publication, distinguishes a torn final record from middle-chain corruption, enforces exact open-intent/observation matching and closed phase transitions, exposes recovery facts including open effects, and seals only shared-contract-valid terminal receipts. Covered by warning-denied journal, restart, corruption, durability, and receipt tests.
data.description: Implement the helper's single-writer, append-only, hash-chained write-ahead journal and receipt vault for mutually exclusive enrollment or activation transactions. Persist intent before every effect, exact observation afterward, durable phase transitions, terminal receipts, and manual-recovery notices using owner-protected crash/power-safe files.
data.title: M11.1 — Implement the enrollment and activation journal
